authority: D-SSM-17 (registry-validated language parameter) + D-SSM-19 (Turkish path) in .claude/memory/DECISIONS.md; architecture s2b. The API enum is GENERATED from this file - adding a language by editing an enum elsewhere is a violation of D-SSM-17.

states_legend.SINGING_PROVEN: we generated singing on OUR route and the PER gate passed on >=3 songs (accepted for vocal.mode=sung)
states_legend.ENGINEERING_PATH_ESTABLISHED: mechanism + evidence exist (phoneme table, G2P tiers, ASR leg, metric); MEASUREMENT is the only remaining step; refused for sung with this named unlock
states_legend.DOCUMENTED_CONVERGENT: >=2 independent primary sources enumerate it for singing; unmeasured by us
states_legend.UNDOCUMENTED: no primary source enumerates it for singing
states_legend.SPEECH_PROVEN: per-language speech measured on our TTS route (accepted for vocal.mode=spoken)
states_legend.PENDING_MEASUREMENT: the route is generation-proven but the per-language measurement has not been run

zero_singing_proven_note: en became the FIRST SINGING_PROVEN language on 2026-08-24 (bar n=14 vocadito + 3/3 passing sung takes; artefacts named in the en entry). Every other language still needs its own calibrated bar and >=3 passing songs (D-SSM-17) - tr is next (corpus licence-blocked, see data/calibration_corpus.json).

languages.label: English
languages.evidence: SINGING_PROVEN 2026-08-24: bar calibrated from n=14 vocadito EN human recordings (CC BY 4.0; artifacts/song-rnd/en-bar/en_bar_calibration.json, one-sided upper tolerance limit, exact noncentral-t k=2.1088, p=0.9, gamma=0.95) AND 3/3 generated sung takes passed the PER gate against that bar (artifacts/song-rnd/en-proof/report.json: PER 0.0, 0.0, 0.3294 vs bar 0.654862; full-mix measurement, a HARDER condition than the solo-vocal corpus - conservative evidence). Earlier trail preserved: GTSinger (NeurIPS 2024) + Mureka FAQ both enumerate English for singing; EN G2P path deployed 2026-08-17; ground-truth control on disk.

stage6-per-v1.separator: SCNet XL IHF, 4-stem — music_studio/data/separators.json (chosen on SDR, MIT licence)
stage6-per-v1.vocal_stem: the separated VOCAL stem, never the mix — the mix leaks accompaniment into the ASR
stage6-per-v1.g2p: music_studio/g2p_tr.py three tiers (MFA lexicon -> sourced rules -> phonetisaurus), per language
stage6-per-v1.scorer: music_studio/per_gate.py, line-aware, over a REFERENCE LATTICE of pronunciation variants
stage6-per-v1.allophone_folding: music_studio/g2p_tr.py ALLOPHONE_FOLD — collapses alphabet differences only
stage6-per-v1.what_it_cannot_do: it measures INTELLIGIBILITY, not whether the singing is good; that verdict is Berk's (MANDATE Clause 19) and the gate never claims it

a14_contract.enum_generation: the API's language enum is GENERATED from this file by import (music_studio/models.py reads it); it is never hand-listed in param_spec.json
a14_contract.honesty_rule: a field whose value is NOT_MEASURED carries the REASON and the items that block it. A number printed beside a verified one reads as verified, so no field is ever filled with a plausible figure.
